recognize_zh: 抹片中一群異常前骨髓球，細胞質塞滿粗大的紫紅色嗜苯胺顆粒甚至遮住細胞核，核呈腎形或雙葉摺疊，部分細胞邊緣有無顆粒的藍色細胞質突起，符合急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）。
features: Cytoplasm packed with coarse, dense purple-red azurophilic granules partly obscuring the nucleus
Reniform, folded or bilobed nuclei with fine chromatin
Pale-blue agranular cytoplasmic blebs (pseudopod-like) at the cell margins
Auer rod bundles (faggot cells) not clearly seen in this field
Few red cells and scattered platelets in background
describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules that partly obscure the nuclear outline. Nuclei are reniform, folded or bilobed with fine chromatin. Several cells show agranular pale-blue cytoplasmic protrusions at the periphery. Distinct Auer rod bundles are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent coagulation studies and confirmation of PML::RARA by FISH or RT-PCR are recommended.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocytes (G-CSF effect or marrow recovery)
ddx.vs: Reactive promyelocytes have a round eccentric nucleus with a perinuclear Golgi clearing and orderly maturation to myelocytes, without bilobed nuclei or dense granules obscuring the nucleus.
These show myeloblasts with fewer granules, perinuclear hofs and single slender Auer rods with maturing neutrophils, and lack PML::RARA.
The variant has bilobed nuclei with sparse or invisible granules, whereas these cells are frankly hypergranular.
Cup-like blasts have a nuclear invagination with less cytoplasmic granulation and are CD34-/HLA-DR- like APL, so molecular testing separates them.
